programs.title: Ant Anstead Master Mechanic
programs.desc: Ant's ambitious Alfa build is in the home stretch, but his new baby could come any day now  Ant gets good news about his plan to unveil the car at the US Grand Prix, but a million critical details must still be sorted out.

programs.title: Extreme Car Hoarders: Pure American Muscle
programs.desc: Rick and the crew try to fulfill Chuck's plans for a double build of a 1968 Dodge Charger and a 1970 BMW for a corrections officer and his girlfriend.

programs.title: Diesel Brothers: Clash of the Titan
programs.desc: The Dieselsellerz pull out all the stops to build a new giveaway: a Nissan Titan with a near-zero emission Cummins engine  Heavy D fulfills his lifelong dream to drive a truck in Monster Jam.
